Factor \(a^3-1=(a-1)(a^2+a+1)\) and \(a^3+1=(a+1)(a^2-a+1)\). Canceling \(a^2+a+1\) and rewriting the division gives \(\frac{(a+1)^2}{a-1/a}\cdot(a-1)\cdot\frac{a+1/a-1}{(a+1)(a^2-a+1)}\). Cancel one \(a+1\): \(\frac{(a+1)(a-1)(a+1/a-1)}{(a-1/a)(a^2-a+1)}\). Now \((a+1)(a-1)=a^2-1\), \(a+1/a-1=\frac{a^2-a+1}{a}\), and \(a-1/a=\frac{a^2-1}{a}\). Therefore the expression equals \(\frac{(a^2-1)\cdot\frac{a^2-a+1}{a}}{\frac{a^2-1}{a}\cdot(a^2-a+1)}=1\). Thus the simplified expression is \(\boxed{1}\).
